SELECT SEQ_CLASS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CLASS ( CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_DETAIL, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT ) VALUES ( #{class_idx}, #{provider_idx}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{minor_field_idx}, #{minor_region_idx}, #{region_detail}, #{price}, #{photo}, #{video}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, SYSDATE, #{max_user_cnt} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAJOR_FIELD_IDX, MAJOR_FIELD_CD FROM MAJOR_FIELD ORDER BY MAJOR_FIELD_IDX
SELECT MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM MINOR_FIELD WHERE MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = #{major_field_idx} ORDER BY MINOR_FIELD_NM
SELECT MAJOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_NM FROM MAJOR_REGION ORDER BY MAJOR_REGION_IDX
SELECT MINOR_REGION_IDX, DISTRICT_NM FROM MINOR_REGION WHERE MAJOR_REGION_IDX = #{major_region_idx} ORDER BY DISTRICT_NM

SELECT CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_DETAIL, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT FROM CLASS WHERE PROVIDER_IDX = #{provider_idx}
AND END_DATE < SYSDATE ORDER BY END_DATE DESC
AND START_DATE <= SYSDATE AND END_DATE >= SYSDATE ORDER BY START_DATE DESC
AND START_DATE > SYSDATE ORDER BY START_DATE ASC
ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT u.USER_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CASE WHEN c.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN c.PHOTO WHEN co.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN co.PHOTO ELSE NULL END AS PROVIDER_PHOTO FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN COACH c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY co ON u.USER_IDX = co.USER_IDX WHERE u.USER_IDX = #{provider_idx}

SELECT CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_DETAIL, PRICE, PHOTO, VIDEO, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT FROM CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}

SELECT e.ENROLL_IDX, e.CLASS_IDX, e.USER_IDX, e.STATUS, e.ENROLLED_AT, e.COMPLETED_AT, u.USER_NAME, CASE WHEN c.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN c.PHONE WHEN co.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN co.PHONE ELSE NULL END AS PHONE FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT e INNER JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COACH c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY co ON u.USER_IDX = co.USER_IDX WHERE e.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} AND e.STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY e.COMPLETED_AT DESC, e.ENROLLED_AT DESC
SELECT h.TAGS FROM HASHTAG h INNER JOIN CLASS_HASHTAG ch ON h.HASHTAG_IDX = ch.HASHTAG_IDX WHERE ch.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY h.HASHTAG_IDX

SELECT mf.MAJOR_FIELD_CD, mnf.MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM CLASS c INNER JOIN MINOR_FIELD mnf ON c.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = mnf.MINOR_FIELD_IDX INNER JOIN MAJOR_FIELD mf ON mnf.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = mf.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX WHERE c.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}

SELECT mr.REGION_NM, mnr.DISTRICT_NM FROM CLASS c INNER JOIN MINOR_REGION mnr ON c.MINOR_REGION_IDX = mnr.MINOR_REGION_IDX INNER JOIN MAJOR_REGION mr ON mnr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX = mr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX WHERE c.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS SET INTRO = #{intro}, MINOR_REGION_IDX = #{minor_region_idx}, REGION_DETAIL = #{region_detail}, PHOTO = #{photo}, VIDEO = #{video}, START_DATE = #{start_date}, END_DATE = #{end_date}, MAX_USER_CNT = #{max_user_cnt} WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT mr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX, mr.REGION_NM AS MAJOR_REGION_NM, mnr.MINOR_REGION_IDX, mnr.DISTRICT_NM AS MINOR_REGION_NM FROM MINOR_REGION mnr INNER JOIN MAJOR_REGION mr ON mnr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX = mr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX WHERE mnr.MINOR_REGION_IDX = #{minorRegionIdx}

SELECT rc.REVIEW_CLASS_IDX, rc.REVIEWER_IDX, rc.CLASS_IDX, rc.RATING, rc.TAG, rc.CONTENT, rc.CREATED_AT, u.USER_NAME AS REVIEWER_NAME, CASE WHEN coach.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN coach.PHOTO WHEN comp.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN comp.PHOTO ELSE NULL END AS REVIEWER_PHOTO FROM REVIEW_CLASS rc INNER JOIN USERS u ON rc.REVIEWER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COACH coach ON u.USER_IDX = coach.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY comp ON u.USER_IDX = comp.USER_IDX WHERE rc.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY rc.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) FROM REVIEW_CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM REVIEW_CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
SELECT CLASS_IDX FROM CLASS WHERE PROVIDER_IDX = #{provider_idx} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
